title: Powers of the field points
statement: Let $k,n$ be positive integers with $k\le n$. For every $q\in\{0,\ldots,k-2\}$ and every index $j\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the field isomorphism sends the encoded binary modular power of the point indexed by $j$, with exponent $q+1$, to the $(q+1)$st power of that field point.
hypotheses_covered: The independence order k is positive
q is an index from 0 through k−2
j is an index from 0 through n−1
